description: Three attenuator or attenuverter channels with chained outputs, so leaving an output unpatched sends that channel on to the one below

params.text: Sets the gain of that channel: from 0 to 1 in attenuator mode, or from -1 to 1 in attenuverter mode, where the centre mutes it
Switches that channel between an attenuator, whose gain runs from 0 to 1, and an attenuverter, whose gain runs from -1 to 1

inputs.text: The signal for that channel; with nothing patched it reads a constant 5V, so the knob puts out an adjustable offset instead

outputs.text: That channel, summed with any channel above it whose own output is unpatched

notes: the module is monophonic: on a polyphonic cable only the first channel is read.
